hypothesis: Increase DIRECT_EVAL_WEIGHT to rely more on direct world sampling rather than the CFR prior, as the CFR budget fraction was reduced to 10% and might be too noisy to merit a 30% weight.
rationale: In Phase 74, CFR_BUDGET_FRACTION was reduced to 0.10, but DIRECT_EVAL_WEIGHT remained at 0.70. A minimally trained CFR prior is likely injecting noise into the final probabilities. Trusting the direct eval more should reduce variance and improve decision quality.
